{{Top|leg}}
'''Echo Ten''' was the callsign given to a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in [[Echo Flight]], a [[N-X Police Cruiser/Legends|N-X Police Cruisers]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]].

During the [[battle at Station  TFP-9]], the pilot reported that the unknown [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] were causing a lot of damage.<ref name="The Starfighter Trap">{{GamerCite|1|The Starfighter Trap}}</ref>
